newsitem.title: USA: Primadonna gets Mississippi Gaming OK.
newsitem.headline: Primadonna gets Mississippi Gaming OK.

text.p: Primadonna Resorts Inc Wednesday said the Mississippi Gaming Commission approved an application by its PRMA-MS subsidiary to operate a gaming establishment in the state.
In a statement, Primadonna said it sought approvals following its announcement of the signing of a letter of intent to purchase certain assets of BH Acquisition Corp in Biloxi, Mississippi.

"We are happy to have completed this step in Primadonna's growth and our first venture outside of Nevada," Gary Primm, president and chief executive officer, said. "We will continue to work towards satisfactory completion of due diligence and negotiation of agreements in this matter."
Primadonna owns and operates three casino resorts -- Buffalo Bill's Resort & Casino, Primadonna Resort & Casino, and Whiskey Pete's Hotel & Casino -- at the Nevada/southern California border.
